note: Manual callouts for photos the WCS path can't solve (Moon/planets — computeAtRuntime, no fixed RA/Dec). Keyed by photo `path`. Each callout pins a catalog object to a pixel position expressed as a percentage of the source image's natural width/height. Optional `rPctW` overrides the default ring radius (as a percentage of image width) — use when a body's visible disc is much larger than the default 21-px focus ring. `isCenter:true` marks the framed subject (yellow ring).

photos/Pluto_1.jpg.note: Pluto is a 15th-magnitude dot in a dense Sagittarius field and there is no way to pick it out by eye. Position computed from Keplerian elements for the capture time (2026-08-26T04:45:37 UTC) and projected through the Seestar stack's own plate solve. It lands 1.7 arcmin from the frame centre, which independently agrees with the album app's ephemeris (1.6 arcmin) — the mount centres what it tracks. Good to a few arcmin: enough to say WHICH dot, not to measure one. The frame's own RA/DEC keywords are stale and sit 23 arcmin away; do not use them.
